szoveg_eredeti:
Hi Product Hunt community, Pablo here, co-founder of throxy. We came through Y Combinator last year and run outbound for great b2b companies, from F500 to fast scaling start ups.

Today we're launching local-language calling. When a lead comes up, our system checks where they are and routes the call to an SDR who speaks their language. The SDR opens in that language. That matters most when the person picking up runs a factory floor in Lyon and has never taken a cold call in English.

Some numbers since we finished YC last Spring: we've served 149 companies and booked more than 4500 meetings. We've now made over 3.8M+ cold calls.

Are you a fit for throxy? We work best with B2B software companies that have a working product, a clear buyer and a market that's hard to reach with email sequences alone.

We'd love your feedback, especially from anyone who sells into Europe. What would you want to hear in the first ten seconds of a cold call?

Weboldal: https://throxy.com/
